title: Sprint-to-launch choreography: milestone heatmap, dependency slack, and release-note bundling
creator: Anika Rao
description:
Goal: produce a single operational choreography that maps sprint-level work to launch milestones, enforces scope-lock windows, defines cut criteria per component (API, Console, Runtime), and produces a lightweight bundled release-notes artifact for external communications and internal handoffs. This ticket coordinates cross-functional inputs (Engineering, Design, Docs, Support, Sales) and creates an actionable timeline with slack buffers for dependency resolution and last-mile fixes.

Scope: 1) milestone heatmap (sprint -> launch day mapping) showing ownership, risk level, and required signoffs; 2) explicit scope-lock definitions per subsystem (what must be merged and gated vs what can be postponed to a patch); 3) cut criteria matrix with automated signals for go/no-go (test pass thresholds, SLO smoke checks, performance regression deltas); 4) release-note bundling rules and templates to reduce reviewer churn and ensure customer-facing clarity; 5) comms runway (internal stakeholder updates, embargo windows, release notes publication cadence).

Out-of-scope: deep engineering runbooks for each runtime optimization step (those remain in ENG tickets), and long-form product marketing collateral (handled by PMM via separate tasks).
acceptance_criteria: Milestone heatmap published to Confluence with owner and triage plan for each entry
Scope-lock checklist defined and agreed by ENG/Design/PM leads
Cut criteria matrix automated into the release dashboard (smoke test + perf guardrails) or documented with a manual checklist
A finalized release-notes bundle template and initial draft for the launch features linked in the ticket
Stakeholder comms plan scheduled (launch rehearsal, embargo, customer notification)
risks_and_mitigation: Late-breaking regressions in runtime perf: mitigation = pre-launch stress window + conservative performance guardrail that triggers rollback or canary hold
Unresolved cross-team dependency (Console UX for a runtime flag): mitigation = gated fallback UI + prioritized cross-team pairing sessions
Release-note review bottleneck: mitigation = parallelized review lanes (engineering, legal, PMM) and a 48-hour hard cutoff for edits
Over-ambitious scope creep in final sprint: mitigation = enforced scope-lock and earmarked patch window after GA
communications_plan: Weekly sync: Tuesdays 10am PT — cross-functional status and blocker triage (ENG Tech Lead, Design Lead, Docs, PMM, Support)
Launch rehearsal: 3 days before target release — full run-through of rollback, monitoring, and customer comms
Embargo and press window: define in PMM doc and lock 72 hours before release
Release notes publication: draft by engineering PMs 7 days before release, reviews complete 48 hours before release, final publish coordinated via Console release pipeline
deliverables: Release-notes bundle (Google Doc draft link placeholder https://drive.google.com/release-notes-pm-66041)
